title: Alpenrosenbahn Gondola Westendorf & Alpinolino
name: Alpenrosenbahn Gondola Westendorf & Alpinolino
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpenrosenbahn in Westendorf: 6-seater gondola ascending to 1,770 m to the Alpinolino discovery park featuring panoramic trails, Himmelsteig, and marmot rally.
beschreibung:
Overview

The modern Alpenrosenbahn Westendorf is located in the sunny municipality of Westendorf in Tyrol's Brixental (Kitzbühel district) at a valley elevation of around 800 meters. Operating in two sections, this powerful 6-passenger gondola lift provides access to the scenic local mountain Choralpe at an elevation of 1,770 meters in the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Upon arriving at the top, visitors enter the expansive hiking and family adventure realm of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental, which ranks among Tyrol's most appealing summer alpine destinations thanks to its award-winning alpine discovery park Alpinolino.

Alpinolino Discovery Park & Panoramic Vistas

The centerpiece at the top station is the alpine nature and adventure park Alpinolino Westendorf: following the motto 'play, explore, and discover,' the approx. 1.5-kilometer circular trail 'Himmelsteig' leads families through alpine nature. At interactive stations, children can test their agility against alpine animals – such as long-jumping against a mountain hare or deer, exploring touch and scent trails, or racing on the exhilarating marmot rally. For avid hikers, the Choralpe offers spectacular high-altitude paths: the panoramic trail to Brechhorn (2,032 m) or the hike down to the scenic Kreuzjöchlsee lake unveil magnificent views of the Wilder Kaiser massif, the Kitzbüheler Horn, and the glaciated peaks of the Zillertal Alps. In addition, paragliders prize the Choralpe as one of the premier thermal launch sites in Western Austria.

Visit & Getting There

The Alpenrosenbahn Westendorf operates daily from late May to late October continuously from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to the Alpinolino adventure park is included free of charge in the cable car ticket. Lift fares (as of the 2025/2026 season): round trip adults approx. €31.50, youth approx. €23.50, children (born 2009–2018) approx. €16.00. Holders of the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer-Card cable car pass ride for free. Getting there by car: Via the B170 (Brixentalstraße) to Westendorf, follow the signage to the gondola at Bergliftstraße 18 (large free parking lot). By public transport: ÖBB/S-Bahn to Westendorf station, followed by an approx. 10-minute walk or directly by hikers' shuttle bus to the valley station.

Tips

The gondolas and main paths of the Alpinolino adventure park up to the Choralpe summit restaurant are paved and well-suited for all-terrain strollers. Take a break at the Bergrestaurant Choralpe and savor crispy Tyrolean Kaiserschmarrn on the expansive panoramic terrace with unobstructed views across the Brixental mountain landscape.
